Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the BTC/USDT spot price on Binance reaches $90,000.00 or higher at any point before the start of September 1, 2026 (UTC).
- "No": Wins if the BTC/USDT spot price on Binance does not reach $90,000.00 at any point before the start of September 1, 2026 (UTC).

Clarifications:
- "Reaches $90,000" means any single trade or last-traded price on the BTC/USDT spot pair on Binance is recorded at or above $90,000.00 before the market's settlement time.
